_comment: Workbook exercise air-excess-oa-cost (docs/workbook/air-excess-oa-cost.md): the excess-outside-air cost (0.107, #195) on the synthetic-ahu-excess-oa units (generated by CAMBER, no real building). outdoor_air_fraction judges the OA fraction against the declared 20 % minimum (min_oa_pct) and carries the cost inputs; economizer_high_limit judges the samples above the economizer's 65 F high limit. Read the cost in the RCx layout. The variants air-excess-oa-cost--no-min (no declared minimum) and air-excess-oa-cost--design-oa (a design OA airflow for the unit that trends no supply airflow) show the estimate declining and then priced from the config.
